review: Provisional build-agent judgments against bounded cited inputs, not independent review or source fact checking.
scope: All four text fields of all five selected historical World stories, including a three-input composite. Briefs, triage and rejected responses are outside this story-field audit. Claims requiring uncited background are unsupported under this bounded-input policy, not declared false in the world.
